errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the grouped bar chart as a simple bar chart with only one bar per model. It fails to describe the two separate groups of bars for 'Emoji Tweets' and 'Overall Tweet' and instead reports single, inaccurate values for each model.
The two bars for 'VADER' have approximate accuracy values of 0.46 and 0.47. The reported value of 0.56 is incorrect.
The two bars for 'ChatGPT' have approximate accuracy values of 0.67 and 0.66. The reported value of 0.6 is a significant underestimation.
The two bars for 'TextBlob' have approximate accuracy values of 0.33 and 0.40. Reporting a single value of 0.3 is an inaccurate generalization that ignores the second data point.
